title: Hearty German Stew
description: A comforting, slow-cooked stew filled with tender lentils and flavorful spices. Serve with a side of crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add lentils, beef broth, water, and tomato paste. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
